explanations.headline: H10’s run pulled defender away creating big space

claims.text: Metrica Home's H10 ran far without touching the ball and pulled a defender away from a teammate's spot.
This left much more room for the teammate to receive the pass and take a shot soon after.

explanations.headline: H10’s run pulls marker A3 away, opening space for a teammate

claims.text: Player H10 ran 21.5 metres while marker A3 followed closely over 18 metres, matching H10’s run direction very closely.
This movement pulled marker A3 11.8 metres from the receiving zone, greatly increasing the space there.
The nearest defender to the receiving spot moved further away, allowing a teammate to receive the ball and shoot 2.3 seconds after the pass.

explanations.headline: Off-ball run pulls defender away, increasing space for teammate

claims.text: Player H10 made an off-ball run covering 21.5 metres over 5 seconds before the pass at 22.56 seconds with a detector confidence of 0.97.
Defender A3 followed H10's run with a cosine similarity of 0.97 and was pulled 11.8 metres away from the target receiving zone.
Receiving space in the left half-space of the attacking third increased from 34 to 252 square metres, representing a 7.5-fold gain at the time the pass was played.
The nearest defender to the receiving spot was 3.3 metres away at run start and 9.0 metres away when the pass was played; the shot occurred 2.3 seconds after the pass.
